notes: FraxlendPairCore.sol:1277 lines — VaultAccount (amount,shares) dual accounting for assets and borrows; _addInterest before every external fn; _isSolvent LTV check; dual-oracle low/high exchange rates with maxOracleDeviation; deposit/mint/redeem/withdraw + borrow/repay/liquidate/addCollateral/removeCollateral paths.

FraxlendPair.sol:648 lines — ERC20 fToken + ERC4626 views (convertToAssets/Shares, maxDeposit/Mint/Withdraw/Redeem), admin setters (setOracle/setMaxLTV/setRateContract/setLiquidationFees/changeFee) with one-way revocation, withdrawFees, setSwapper, granular pauses (borrow/deposit/repay/withdraw/liquidate/interest).
VaultAccount.sol: toShares/toAmount with roundUp flag — share-math rounding is the inflation/precision boundary.

VariableInterestRate.sol: kinked curve + half-life drift, v2 rate interface; deployed reference-pair rate contract is VariableInterestRateSettable v3.0.0 (AccessControl + SETTER_ROLE), NOT in repo — sourcify sources only.

Oracle: single dual-oracle per pair via exchangeRateInfo; deployed reference oracle SfrxEthUsdTripleOracle v3.0.0 (Chainlink ETH/USD + FRAX/USD, Redstone, Curve EMA, UniV3 TWAP 900s), NOT in any public repo — sourcify sources only. Repo has DualOracleChainlinkUniV3.sol only.
Deployer: CREATE2 via SSTORE2-split creation code, registers pairs in registry; HEAD == deployed (MATCH). Registry deployed is OLDER Ownable version with salt tracking, not HEAD Ownable2Step.

Trust boundaries: any user can deposit/borrow/repay/liquidate (permissionless pairs); owner=timelock 0xB174.. + circuit breaker can pause/set params; oracle/rate contracts are admin-set per pair with one-way setter revocation; swappers are owner-approved for leveraged/liquidation swaps.

Reference pair 0xaB3cb84c310186B2Fa4B4503624A5D90b5DcB22D (v3.1.0): 4.59M frxUSD supplied, 3.42M borrowed, 4,329 sfrxETH collateral, maxLTV 75%, unpaused, unlimited borrow/deposit limits. Fork PoCs must set evm_version=cancun (frxUSD PUSH0).
